select u.user_id as employeeId, p.employee_no as employeeNo, p.position_no as positionNo, u.nick_name as employeeName, u.phonenumber as phone, p.id_type as idType, p.id_number as idNumber, p.current_address as currentAddress, p.employee_status as employeeStatus, p.employee_category as employeeCategory, u.status as accountStatus, u.dept_id as shopDeptId, d.dept_name as shopDeptName, u.dept_id as deptId, d.dept_name as deptName, p.legal_entity_id as legalEntityId, p.legal_entity_code as legalEntityCode, p.legal_entity as legalEntityName, sp.post_id as postId, sp.post_code as postCode, sp.post_name as postName, p.job_grade as jobGradeCode, p.job_grade as jobGradeName, p.direct_supervisor_user_id as directSupervisorId, p.direct_supervisor as directSupervisorName, p.department_supervisor as departmentSupervisorName, p.work_location as workLocation, p.work_city_level as workCityLevel, p.contract_type as contractTypeCode, p.contract_term as contractTermCode, p.social_type as socialTypeCode, coalesce(p.renewal_count, 0) as renewalCount, p.entry_date as entryDate, p.contract_start_date as contractStartDate, p.contract_end_date as contractEndDate, p.probation_start_date as probationStartDate, p.probation_end_date as probationEndDate, p.actual_regularization_date as actualRegularizationDate, p.leave_date as leaveDate, p.base_salary as baseSalary, p.post_salary as postSalary, p.field_allowance as fieldAllowance, p.performance_salary as performanceSalary, p.salary_total as salaryTotal, p.salary_version as salaryVersion from sys_user u inner join sys_user_profile p on p.user_id = u.user_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = u.dept_id left join sys_user_post sup on sup.user_id = u.user_id and sup.post_id = ( select sup2.post_id from sys_user_post sup2 inner join sys_post sp2 on sp2.post_id = sup2.post_id where sup2.user_id = u.user_id and sp2.status = '0' order by sp2.post_sort asc, sp2.post_id asc limit 1 ) left join sys_post sp on sp.post_id = sup.post_id where u.user_id = #{userId} and u.del_flag = '0' for update
